map.FCF 收益率 = 8/100 = 8%。即市值每 100 元对应 8 元自由现: FCF yield = 8/100 = 8%. That is, every 100 yuan of market cap corresponds to 8 yuan of free cash flow.
map.FCF 不变=8 亿、市值涨到 120 亿：FCF 收益率=8/120≈6.67: FCF unchanged at 800M, market cap rises to 12B: FCF yield = 8/120 ≈ 6.67%, attractiveness declines.
map.FCF 用哪种口径？: Which FCF measure should be used?
map.常用经营现金流减资本开支（FCFF 或 FCFE），需与市值（股权）或 EV（整: Typically operating cash flow minus capital expenditure (FCFF or FCFE); it must match market cap (equity) or EV (whole firm), and the basis must be consistent to be comparable.
map.FCF 收益率比 PE 好？: Is FCF yield better than PE?
map.现金流较利润难粉饰，但 FCF 波动大（受 capex 周期影响），宜用多年平均: Cash flow is harder to dress up than profit, but FCF is volatile (affected by capex cycles); judge using a multi-year average.
map.FCF 收益率（本页代码口径）：收益率=每股自由现金流÷股价×100（%）；联动: FCF yield (this page's code basis): yield = free cash flow per share ÷ share price × 100 (%); linked values: implied multiple = 100 ÷ max(yield, 10⁻⁹) (years), P/FCF = share price ÷ max(FCF per share, 10⁻¹²), decimal form = yield ÷ 100. Validation: empty or invalid input on either field prompts and stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; the FCF yield is the free-cash-flow version of the earnings yield, so a higher value means cheaper valuation on a cash-flow basis.
